newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas ticks lower again in minimal trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas ticks lower again in minimal trade.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures tracked lower in desultory trade on Wednesday afternoon, with only a single deal for five lots, the minimum volume, done in the later session.
September was done at 10.20 pence a therm, down from the 10.50 pence done earlier in the day and a fall of 0.50 pence from the previous settlement price.
The only other trade done was in July, the front month, at 10.30 pence a therm.
Both July and September had been traded at higher prices on Tuesday, despite weakness on the OTC market, so Wednesday's falls bring them closer back in line with physical levels.
Although all months were offered by the close, bids were only seen in three separate contracts, July, September and February.

The weakness on the market was illustrated by the front three months, where offers at the close were all below the previous settlement, although offers were higher than the settlement on all months further forward.
The final month, June, was offered at 11.20 pence a therm, but it has yet to trade since opening.
